provenance.test_card_used: 4100 2800 0002 0007 (Visa) - Razorpay's documented test card for gateway_technical_error
provenance.how_captured: A real order was created via app.executor.RazorpayExecutor's live path, checked out through Razorpay's actual test-mode checkout.js with the card above, and the mock bank's Failure button was clicked. This is a genuine Razorpay API response from a real test-mode network round-trip, not a fabricated payload - see sim/demo_live_trace.py.
provenance.note_on_the_error_shape: The documented test card is supposed to produce error_reason=gateway_technical_error, but the mock bank's Failure button returned a generic error_reason=payment_failed / error_source=gateway instead - the same generic shape sim/generate_batch.py's GENERIC_BANK_DECLINE template models (source=bank there vs source=gateway here), and exactly the kind of unmapped, ambiguous decline REASON_TO_CLASS in app/classifier.py has no entry for. Documented behaviour not matching live behaviour is now a pattern in this repo - see app/executor.py's module docstring for the Orders/receipt finding from the same day.
provenance.pii_excluded: The real payment object also carried contact/email fields entered during checkout; both are omitted here deliberately - they play no role in classification and there is no reason to keep contact information in a committed fixture.

customer.archetype: ordinary - SYNTHETIC, not part of the real capture. Razorpay's payment object carries no customer-history fields; only the error/instrument/amount fields above came from the real API response.
